title: Guacamole
summary: Classic guacamole with lime, onion, tomato and coriander. Best made a couple of hours ahead at most.

steps.text: Cut the avocados in half, remove the stones and scoop the flesh into a bowl.
Mash with a fork until it is as smooth or as chunky as you like.
Stir in the onion, the tomato, the coriander, the lime juice, the salt and the pepper, with the chilli if using.
Taste and adjust the seasoning, adding more lime or salt if it needs it.
Serve with tortilla chips, tacos, grilled meat or burgers.

tips: It is best made up to 2-4 hours before serving, and keeps for about 24 hours at most, though the flavour and colour are best on the day. For guests, I make it 1-2 hours ahead.
To keep it green, press cling film directly onto the surface so no air touches it, and keep it in the fridge. A little extra lime juice on top helps, but the airtight seal matters most.
A thin brown layer is only oxidation: scrape it off, or stir it in if it is slight. The guacamole underneath is fine.
